messages:
sophie: Heads up — customer 'Acme Payments' on prod-nyc is hitting partial SSE responses then an immediate client reconnect that reauths and incurs double billing. Happens after ~15s of idle. We see first few tokens, then a 0-byte gap, client reconnects with a new token and continues.

mike: Can you paste the client headers and our edge logs? Any Cloudflare / ALB in front?

sophie: Stack: Cloudflare spectrum -> ALB -> nginx sidecar -> our origin. Sample client request: `curl -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream`

sophie: From edge logs (redacted):
```
CF-Connecting-IP: 35.196.XX.XX
Connection: keep-alive
Accept: text/event-stream
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Encoding: identity
```
Response pattern: first chunk with `data: {"delta":...}` then ~15s silence, origin still shows active, then ALB sends `FIN`, client reconnects, next request gets 401 (token rotated) -> duplicate billing.

ingress-bot: [alert] spike: SSE reconnects for customer AcmePayments (50/min) — sample trace id 01E9ZQ...

ben: :eyes: this smells like an idle-probe / half-close handshake mismatch between Cloudflare and ALB. Cloudflare will send health or idle probes and ALB may half-close then nginx buffers until window open. If token rotates on reconnect, customer gets charged again.

carla: Quick repro I ran from our corp network: `while true; do curl -N -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" https://staging-redwood/stream | sed -n '1,3p'; sleep 1; done` — reproduced a silent gap then reconnect when we had `keepalive_timeout` mismatched on nginx and ALB idle timeout shorter than Cloudflare.

mike: Can we confirm the following settings?
- ALB idle timeout (target group): 60s vs Cloudflare origin keepalive 90s
- Nginx `keepalive_timeout` (upstream) 75s
- Any proxy (Cloudflare) origin timeouts / request buffering enabled?

sophie: Customer ALB shows 45s idle. Cloudflare origin settings default 120s but Spectrum may behave differently for long lived TCP/HTTP2.

ben: Actionable: set ALB idle timeout to >= Cloudflare origin timeout, disable `proxy_buffering` on nginx for SSE routes, and ensure `Connection: keep-alive` forwarded. Also add a lightweight heartbeat event every 10s from origin to keep proxies from thinking stream is idle.

carla: Patch snippet I used in nginx location /stream: 
```
proxy_set_header Connection '';
proxy_ignore_headers X-Accel-Buffering;
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_set_header X-Accel-Buffering no;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```
Worked in staging — gaps disappeared in my runs.

eng-runtime-oncall: Note on runtime: if we emit empty comment heartbeats `:\n` or `: keepalive\n\n` every 8-10s it prevents middleboxes from half-closing. Also add server-side check to not rotate short-lived tokens during active SSE sessions; tie token TTL to stream session.

mike: For customer-facing workaround: ask them to set ALB idle to 180s (temporary) and disable Cloudflare HTTP/2 connection coalescing for that host, and we will push a heartbeat patch.

sophie: I'll relay to the customer and collect pcap + ALB access logs + Cloudflare ray ids. Also pairing with billing: we need to credit duplicates for reconnect window where token rotated.

ben: Filed INC-2026-789 and assigned to eng-infra + eng-runtime. :thumbsup:

sophie: Thanks — attaching sample pcap & nginx trace to the incident. Will update after ALB change + heartbeat deploy. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
